Conley & Stephenson Law Group
Baytown, TX

Letter of Representation
November 17, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1205
Our client: Charles Velazquez
Date of loss: October 23, 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection
with a recent collision in which a vehicle sideswiped our client while changing lanes.
Our cleint sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment.
Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to this office and do
not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your
insured or any other party attempts to make contact with our client about the claim,
please let us know promptly.
We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to
the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any other policies
that may provide coverage for this loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or
umbrella coverage exists.
We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This
includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes,
repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the
vehicles involved. Please ensure that such materials are not altered, discarded, or
destroyed while the claim is pending.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Williams
Conley & Stephenson Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
